title: On the well-posedness of porous medium equations on general metric measure spaces
summary: On general metric measure spaces, we develop a new well-posedness theory for the signed porous medium equation and its fast diffusion counterpart \[ \partial_t u = \mathcal{L}\left(|u|^{m-1}u\right), \qquad m>0, \] where $\mathcal{L}$ is the associated non-positive self-adjoint operator of a symmetric Dirichlet form. The theory does not rely on a Gelfand triple or compact embeddings; instead, it is built upon the extended Dirichlet space $\mathcal{F}_e$ and auxiliary spaces $V^q:=L^q\cap\mathcal{F}_e$, whose uniform convexity plays a key role in the proof.
